title: What Am I Responsible For?
fullTitle: Soul Feast #41: What Am I Responsible For?
description: Join the Seat of the Soul monthly newsletter and receive weekly, wisdom filled, insights from Gary.
In this illuminating Soul Snack, Gary explores the deeper meaning of responsibility – not in the conventional, duty-bound sense, but as a sacred invitation to become conscious of your choices .
As our world experiences massive transformation and old structures begin to dissolve, Gary guides listeners to focus not on controlling outcomes, but on cultivating authentic power from within.
The question at the heart of this Soul Feast is not what you should be responsible for, but what you truly are responsible for: your intentions .

Gary invites us to see our lives not as random or externally controlled, but as reflections of our own soul-level choices. He shares how responsibility is not about changing the world or managing others’ feelings – it’s about choosing your intention in each moment.

Through powerful metaphors and soul-centered insights, Gary highlights how everything we experience, from joy to pain, is an opportunity for spiritual growth – an invitation from the universe to choose love rather than fear every moment.
Ultimately, this Soul Feast reveals that true responsibility is not a burden, but a blessing.
By aligning with our soul’s intentions and choosing love over fear, we begin to co-create a life of meaning, harmony, and authentic power.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(01:08) — Why trying to manage others’ emotions leads to depletion, and how to release that false sense of control (03:06) — How the new consciousness empowers you to create authentic power by changing yourself, not the world (05:42) — The metaphor of the Earth School and how your life is being shaped by the choices of your soul (10:28) — The drifting boat parable and how it reveals your role in co-creating each life experience (13:55) — Why intention—not action—is what you are truly responsible for, and how it shapes your karma (16:54) — How the universe responds to love and fear not with judgment, but with opportunities for learning

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take out your soul notebook and reflect on this: When was the last time the universe gave you something that supported your spiritual growth? Write freely and honestly. Consider the events – both joyful and painful – that shaped your day. What intentions did you bring to them? How might you shift your perspective to see these experiences as soul-given opportunities for growth and expansion?
